apps.subtitle: Recovery, strain and sleep from your own strap, offline.
apps.localizedDescription: Zoop pairs with a WHOOP strap you own over Bluetooth and computes recovery, strain, sleep and stress on your iPhone. No account, no cloud. Not affiliated with WHOOP.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Zoop connects directly to your WHOOP strap over Bluetooth to read heart rate, R-R intervals, battery, and sensor data locally on your iPhone. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Zoop reads your own Apple Health data on-device to compute recovery, strain, and sleep. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Zoop writes the metrics it computes from your strap back into Apple Health, on-device and only when you allow it.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Zoop records your route during an outdoor workout to show distance, pace, and a map, and keeps recording while the screen is off. The route stays on your device. Nothing leaves it.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Zoop uses the microphone to let you ask the coach a question by voice. The audio is transcribed on-device and never leaves your iPhone.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Zoop reads your iPhone's step count for a walking or running workout to show steps in the activity summary. It stays on your device. Nothing leaves it.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Zoop transcribes your question on-device so you can ask the coach out loud instead of typing. Audio never leaves your iPhone.
